title: Uses along Esplanade
previewText: Uses fronting on the Esplanade shall be limited to the uses listed under Use Groups I, II and III, except that in the areas indicated as permitted commercial locations in Appendix 2.3, in the lowest story other than a basement in any building, eating or drinking establishments listed under Use Group VI shall be permitted.
